name: mRAG
description: A unified multimodal retrieval-augmented generation system designed to process and integrate information across text, image, table, and video modalities. The benchmark includes queries spanning these modalities and evaluates retrieval accuracy and response quality using the Deepeval framework.
reputation: A very recent multimodal RAG benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest as an emerging evaluation setup.
notes: Integrates multiple modalities including text, tables, images, and videos; shows improved retrieval accuracy especially for structured text and tables.
